The green plate

Holger, 23 Sep: the light green reads a little teal, and should be a bit more green. Every version keeps the plate’s lightness (L .851) and changes the hue, the strength, or both. Holger picked version 5 the same day, and the site draws it. Version 1 is the 14 Sep pick it replaced.

1 The nine greens

Down: the hue turns a step at a time toward yellow, away from teal. Across: the green gets stronger. Each cell shows the plate, the Message button at rest and under the pointer, the movement chips as the site draws them, a canasta meld’s count and star on the felt, and the chat.

2 Each version in full

Every colour of the family, every place it draws, and the scheme’s checks. The Inks switch at the top gives every version the inks of the 14 Sep pick instead.

3 Your own

Move the hue and the strength to find a green between the versions. The lab keeps your numbers. Tell me the hue and the strength, and I build that one.

4 How a version is built

The recipe is the one the plate ships with (DESIGN-COLOUR.md 4.2). A version gives a hue h and a strength C. The plate is --to 0.851 C h. The ring is --to 0.760 1.3C h, a third stronger, as the blue plate’s ring is. The hover is color-mix(in srgb, plate 94%, black). The deep ink is L .415 at 89% of the strength the hue can hold there. The link ink is --to 0.543 0.149 h. At hue 135 and C .10 the recipe gives the 14 Sep pick’s colours exactly: #b2dd9b, #8cc36d, #a7d092, #305812 and #468115. At hue 131 and C .13 it gives the colours the site has since 23 Sep: #b0e084, #8ac647, #a5d37c, #375612 and #507f0a.

The inks follow the hue. A dark green turns olive as its hue turns toward yellow, and below hue 133 the screen cannot show the link ink’s full strength, so the card says so. The inks may stay within ten degrees of the plate’s hue (Law 5), so the Inks switch can give every version the 14 Sep inks, #305812 and #468115. The chat and the high reputation badge draw in the plate’s inks too.

Where the green draws. On the site today: the movement up chip on the frontpage board and on the leaderboard pages (--plate-green with --plate-green-ink), and the old ranks page’s rank-up figure. In the icon lab’s version 13 (a proposal): the Message button, the canasta star and the meld’s count, and the inks of the chat and the badge. The board and the chips here are the site’s own markup and CSS (site.css), with the page layout of .lobbyscope turned off inline; the buttons, the tabs and the icons are the icon lab’s drawings.

The history. On 14 Sep the first green, #b3dbad (hue 141.6, C .076, the blue’s own stock), read teal beside the warm paper. The pick moved to #b2dd9b: 6.6 degrees warmer and a third stronger. This lab takes the same two steps further, and on 23 Sep Holger picked version 5. For scale: the friends panel’s lime today, #a9e34b, has the plate’s lightness (L .847) at almost twice its strength (C .188), at hue 128.

5 Beside the red plate

Holger’s two, 5 (his pick) and 8, with the 14 Sep pick, each beside the red plate (#fcbcb4, words in #8b1a1a). First the two plates with words in their inks, then the board, where the site draws the two together.
